baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ ... أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Moses is dispatched with visible markers to open a directed corporate passage: a people separates from plural states of blockage and misplacement and moves toward one illuminating orientation.

activation_trace.role: Sending as release and dispatch supplies the commissioned mover of the passage.
Passage to an outside supplies the actual separation from a prior enclosure or state.
The human collective makes the movement corporate rather than an isolated escape.
Withholding and confinement from a due right supplies the obstructed source-state of the movement.
A conspicuous route-marker makes light a navigable orientation, not merely brightness.

changed_reading.before: A messenger performs a generic rescue from darkness.
changed_reading.after: The ayah scripts an authorized, sign-bearing relocation of a whole people from obstructed placement into a marked and navigable order.

baseline_models.mechanism: The first signs are carried into action, remembrance restores charged episodes to presence, and the resulting passage and recollection become second-order signs. Evidence is recursive rather than a flat list.

activation_trace.role: The visible-marker image spans both the signs initially carried and the signs subsequently found in the event.
A reminder makes what has receded present again, turning event-memory into an active sign-bearing device.
Days as momentous occurrences supply the charged episodes that remembrance reactivates.

changed_reading.before: Miracles and remembered history are two parallel proofs.
changed_reading.after: Given signs initiate a passage whose remembered events train the people to discover further signs, forming a recursive pedagogy of recognition.

baseline_models.mechanism: Intensive endurance holds the self steady long enough for a slight gift or mark to register, while gratitude makes sparse input visibly productive. The pair describes a mode of sign-perception as well as moral qualities.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self against panic supplies continuity under the pressure of the remembered events.
A little input producing a visible effect supplies the receiver's amplifying response to a sign.
Fresh shoots and new growth make grateful reception generative rather than merely verbal.
The visible mark is the input whose effect depends on this holding-and-amplifying receiver.

changed_reading.before: Patient and grateful people are praised after the signs are presented.
changed_reading.after: Patience and gratitude are the coupled receiving apparatus by which pressure is retained and a small disclosure becomes legible and fruitful.

baseline_models.mechanism: The noun for the people activates standing, undertaking, and maintaining branches of its root. Extraction can therefore aim at restoring a corporate body able to rise to, carry, and stabilize an order.

activation_trace.role: The collective of people supplies the direct social anchor.
Rising with resolve toward an undertaking recasts the collective as an active bearer of the passage.
Maintenance, care, and governance supply the durable capacity that liberation must restore.

changed_reading.before: Your people names only the population transported by Moses.
changed_reading.after: The population is to be brought into peoplehood as standing capacity: a collective able to undertake and maintain a life beyond its former confinement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first repeats the complete extraction formula for the Book, adds the Lord's permission, and then gives each messenger the language of his people for clarification. The focus command becomes one instance of authorized translation from disclosure into a people's intelligible route.

activation_trace.role: Ordered written speech supplies the transmissible medium that precedes the repeated extraction.
The repeated passage to an outside establishes the focus command as the surah's program.
Permission and authorization qualify the efficacy of the extraction.
Language and speech supply the people's fitted medium of reception.
Uncovering meaning by speech or sign supplies the messenger's functional work.

structural_cues: 14:1 repeats the full movement from plural darknesses to singular light before the focus ayah.
14:4 places every messenger in the language of his people for clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Book, repeated extraction, permission, matched language, and clarification. I infer that bringing out works through authorized intelligibility rather than bare force. A live alternative is that permission marks divine efficacy generally without specifying a translational mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Moses is simply empowered to perform one rescue.
changed_reading.after: Moses translates divine signs into an intelligible, authorized route by which his people can undergo the surah-wide movement into light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first remembered day combines bestowed good, rescue by separation, severe harm, spared life, and trial. Gratitude then converts reception into increase, while ingratitude covers the gift; divine self-sufficiency prevents the transaction from being read as supplying a need in God.

activation_trace.role: A good condition bestowed as blessing frames the remembered rescue as gift.
Deliverance by separation gives the remembered day the same passage-shape as the focus command.
A slight input showing an enlarged effect supplies gratitude's productive response.
Increase and growth make the consequence of grateful reception explicit.
Covering a blessing supplies the exact counter-operation to grateful amplification.
Self-sufficiency blocks the reading that gratitude increases God rather than the receiver's field of good.

structural_cues: 14:6 nests rescue, slaughter, preserved lives, and trial inside one act of remembrance.
14:7-8 place increase and punishment beside God's complete self-sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mixed rescue-and-trial memory, increase after gratitude, covering after ingratitude, and divine self-sufficiency. I infer that remembrance changes the receiver's capacity and future yield. A live alternative is a direct reward-and-punishment sequence without a perceptual or productive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Days of God are past favors to recall with thanks.
changed_reading.after: A Day of God is a mixed event whose rescue and wound must be held together; grateful reading turns that retained event into increased capacity rather than payment to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Messengers commit to endurance under harm, then opponents mirror the focus verb by threatening to expel them or force their return. Destruction of the wrongdoers and settlement after them reverse coercive counter-extraction. Liberation is therefore a conflict over who controls belonging, exit, and durable habitation.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self against panic supplies the messenger's stance immediately before the expulsion threat.
Forced departure from land, community, or allegiance mirrors and contests the focus ayah's commanded extraction.
The fall into destruction removes the coercive regime that claims the power to expel.
Habitation and settlement supply the positive reversal of threatened exile.
Coercive compulsion names the failed mode of the obstinate power.

structural_cues: 14:13 pairs expulsion with compelled return to the opponents' creed.
14:14 answers the threat with dwelling in the land after those opponents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endurance, counter-expulsion, compelled return, destruction, and replacement by settlement. I infer that the focus darkness includes a coercive belonging-regime that can weaponize exit. A live alternative is to keep the reversal strictly political and spatial without extending it to the focus metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Bringing the people out is a one-directional rescue enacted by an uncontested guide.
changed_reading.after: The extractor enters a struggle in which oppressive orders threaten their own expulsion; patient witness survives until coerced exile is reversed into stable dwelling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covered reception yields work that cannot retain form under pressure, like ash dispersed by a forceful wind. Later, once all have emerged for judgment, panic and patience are equally unable to open an exit. The focus pair is productive during the interval of response, not a technique that reverses terminal fixity.

activation_trace.role: Covering blessing supplies the ungrateful reception attached to the unstable work.
Ash left by burning supplies matter with almost no capacity to preserve the work's form.
A violent wind that lightens and scatters things supplies the pressure that tests retention.
Effective capacity is explicitly absent, making lost agency part of the ash mechanism.
The breaking-off of patience supplies one terminal response now declared ineffective.
Self-restraint supplies the opposite response, likewise unable to create an exit once judgment is fixed.

structural_cues: 14:18 links covered reception, accumulated work, scattering, and inability in one material analogy.
14:21 explicitly equates panic and patience after the collective emergence, because no escape remains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unstable ash-work and a terminal point where neither panic nor patience changes the result. I infer a response-window in which the focus dispositions preserve and grow signs before closure. A live alternative is that 14:21 reports only the condemned speakers' predicament and does not delimit patience generally.

changed_reading.before: Patience and gratitude are timeless badges that remain equally operative in any phase.
changed_reading.after: They are time-sensitive capacities for retaining and growing disclosure before response hardens; neglected signs leave ash-like work and a stage where endurance can no longer reopen the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later leader-follower reckoning separates verbal following from coercive power. The disowned followers hear that there was only a call and their response, not force, and blame returns to each self. This constrains the focus causative: bringing out facilitates accountable response rather than overriding agency.

activation_trace.role: Allegiance and succession supply the social chain whose responsibility later unravels.
Coercive overpowering is the capacity explicitly denied to the caller.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the actual noncoercive trigger.
The split target's forceful pushing supplies the rejected alternative sharpened by the denial of power.
The self as the very person or entity receives responsibility after the call-and-response chain is exposed.

structural_cues: 14:21 stages followers asking former superiors to remove some punishment and receiving no help.
14:22 contrasts no authority with only calling, response, and self-blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed dependency, denied coercive authority, a call, a response, and self-accountability. I infer that the focus command's causative agency is pedagogical and invitational rather than compulsory. A live alternative is that 14:22 limits only the adversarial caller and says nothing direct about Moses' method.

changed_reading.before: Moses brings people out as objects moved by his power.
changed_reading.after: Moses bears signs and calls intelligibly so that people can answer into the route; the guide mediates exit, but reception remains accountable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A good word becomes a living memory-structure: rooted below, branching above, stable through time, and repeatedly productive. The bad word is removed with its root and has no settlement. Reminding the people is therefore not archival recall alone but installation of speech able to persist, branch, and bear renewed effects.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the transmissible seed of the model.
Deep-rootedness supplies durable retention rather than momentary hearing.
Continuance and stability keep the word active across changing conditions.
A high branch emerging from an origin supplies extension without severance from the remembered root.
Each fitting interval supplies repeated temporal yield rather than a single effect.
The explicit aim of re-presentation ties the tree's recurring yield back to the focus reminder.
Removal in full from the root supplies the failure-mode of speech that cannot retain a ground.
Stability and settlement are explicitly absent from the uprooted counter-word.

structural_cues: 14:24-25 joins rooted speech, repeated yield, divine permission, and the purpose that people remember.
14:26-27 contrasts rootless speech with the fixed word by which believers are stabilized.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, root, branch, recurring yield, remembrance, uprooting, and stability. I infer that remembered signs are cultivated as a durable verbal ecology in the people. A live alternative is that the tree remains an independent comparison for good speech rather than a model of the focus command.

changed_reading.before: Reminding means periodically recounting past events.
changed_reading.after: The reminder plants a stable word whose rooted memory can branch and bear fresh signs at successive times; failed remembrance is uprooted speech with no place to stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blessing can be replaced by concealment and route a people into ruin, or apportioned provision can be spent onward. Rain, fruit, vessels, rivers, sun, moon, night, and day form continuous services whose gifts exceed counting. Gratitude becomes correct circulation through a field of provision rather than a verbal receipt.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in place of another supplies the destructive exchange of blessing for concealment.
Bestowed good is the value displaced by the exchange.
Covering blessing supplies the anti-grateful substitute.
Sending wealth out as expenditure supplies an onward route for received provision.
An apportioned gift identifies what is received before it is circulated.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the useful output of the material system.
Directed service toward a purpose makes vessels and rivers channels within the provision system.
Continuous habitual operation supplies the persistence of the sun and moon service.
Exhaustive counting is explicitly exceeded, preventing gratitude from becoming a closed ledger.

structural_cues: 14:28 makes a people's ruin follow the substitution of concealment for blessing.
14:31-34 repeatedly says provision and cosmic services are for you, then declares the blessing-field uncountable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, concealed blessing, expenditure, provision, useful fruit, continuous service, and failed enumeration. I infer a circulation model in which grateful reception keeps gifts moving toward benefit. A live alternative is a sequence of separate duties and creation-signs without a shared flow mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The grateful receiver acknowledges a discrete favor after it arrives.
changed_reading.after: The grateful receiver refuses to replace or cover the gift, recognizes an uncountable support-system, and routes apportioned provision onward into benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abraham settles descendants where cultivation is absent so that they may establish prayer; provision and fruit are sought so gratitude can grow. The root of the focus noun for people recurs in the act of establishing. Corporate standing becomes a practiced, provisioned settlement transmitted across generations.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate habitation supplies the stable site in which a community can be formed.
Cultivation and growth are explicitly negated at the site, supplying the community's initial material deficit.
Rising with resolve toward an undertaking is embodied in establishing prayer.
Apportioned provision supplies the material support for durable standing.
Fresh growth makes gratitude the intended generative outcome of settlement and provision.
Maintenance and care sharpen establishing prayer as an ongoing office rather than a momentary posture.

structural_cues: 14:35-40 moves from a secure place and descendants to settlement, established prayer, provision, gratitude, and renewed prayer for descendants.
The focus root ق و م appears later in forms describing establishment at 14:37 and 14:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a barren settlement, repeated ق و م forms for establishing prayer, provision, fruit, gratitude, and descendants. I infer that standing practice helps constitute the people rescued in the focus. A live alternative is that the shared root is only a lexical recurrence across distinct ordinary senses.

changed_reading.before: The people are a pre-existing group that needs relocation.
changed_reading.after: A people becomes able to stand through settled, repeated practice supported by provision and carried into descendants; liberation culminates in maintained communal capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement repeatedly names a coming charged Day, commands warning before it, uses former dwellings as sign-like examples, depicts transformed earth, and ends by defining the discourse as delivered warning and reminder. The focus memory of God's Days becomes a temporal bridge from past event through present response to future accounting.

activation_trace.role: A momentous occurrence supplies the prospective Day of account.
Warning that awakens caution turns the coming Day into a present demand.
The charged Day is repeated as the deadline at which delayed response is requested too late.
An example functioning as lesson and sign makes former dwellings usable evidence for the future.
Transformation of form makes the future Day a radical changed-state rather than ordinary calendar time.
Delivery of a message supplies the closing definition of the discourse as communication reaching people.
Warning again supplies future-oriented vigilance as a purpose of the delivered message.
Re-presentation in the closing purpose returns directly to the focus command to remind.

structural_cues: 14:41, 14:44, and 14:48 progressively specify a future Day of account, punishment, and transformed creation.
14:45 places past dwellings and examples immediately before that future sequence, while 14:52 closes with delivery, warning, knowledge, and remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered former peoples, repeated future Day scenes, warning, transformation, delivered message, and closing remembrance. I infer a temporal bridge in which past Days train response before the future Day. A live alternative is that the focus Days remain only past episodes and the final Day is related by analogy, not included in their scope.

changed_reading.before: Remembering God's Days looks backward at completed interventions.
changed_reading.after: Remembered interventions become signs that orient present conduct toward the still-coming Day, so reminder joins retrospective history to prospective warning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The judgment scene is remote from the focus and makes the reading surprising, but its explicit eyes, prolonged gaze, and empty hearts remain anchored to the focus destination of illumination. Render this only as a contrastive limit: optical exposure is insufficient for guidance, not as a claim that the focus directly predicts the scene.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the focus destination whose perceptual adequacy is being tested.
Fixed staring supplies intense optical exposure without successful orientation.
Eyesight supplies the literal visual faculty present in the scene.
Inner insight supplies the materially absent counterpart to mere eyesight.
Sustained forward gaze intensifies the contrast between looking and guided perception.
A heart weakened as though absent supplies the failed inward receiver.
Void and empty space supply the heart's non-retention despite open eyes.

changed_reading.before: Movement into light can be reduced to seeing what was formerly hidden.
changed_reading.after: The destination requires an inwardly retaining and discerning receiver; eyes can be maximally exposed while the heart remains void.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The mountain branch of ص ب ر is form-distant from the adjective and should not replace its ordinary endurance sense. It remains worth carrying because the packet later joins removal from state with solid mountains under plot. Render it as an exploratory material analogy for stability under displacement pressure.

activation_trace.role: A mountain and its middle supply a branch-distant image of a held center.
Removal from place or state supplies the displacement pressure exerted by plotting.
A solid elevated mass supplies the explicit material object threatened with movement.
Hardness that stops excavation sharpens the image of resistance to displacement.

changed_reading.before: The intensely patient person only suppresses panic.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the intensely patient person also holds a center like solid terrain when plots seek to shift an entire settled state.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The shared root inventory makes fire a legitimate lexical counterimage to light, and the later fire destination and face-covering fire sharpen the contrast. The reading is still cross-domain and should be rendered as disambiguation, not semantic identity: guiding illumination is not any luminous or burning exposure.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the beneficial destination in the focus.
Burning fire is the neighboring branch that opens the contrast between kinds of luminosity.
Fire as destination supplies a destructive terminus opposed to the focus movement.
Flowing pitch supplies the coating paired with the later fire.
A covering laid over a thing makes the fire an engulfing veil rather than clarifying exposure.
The split target likewise supplies concealment and confirms the covering function without collapsing the mapped roots.
The explicit burning fire covering faces completes the material counterimage to guiding light.

changed_reading.before: Light is beneficial because luminosity itself is beneficial.
changed_reading.after: The focus light is beneficial because it clarifies and orients; the same root-field later supplies fire that covers and consumes, so brightness alone cannot define guidance.

strongest_changes: The exact 14:1 repetition and 14:4 language cue turn Moses' command into authorized translation of signs into a people's route.
14:12-15 mirrors extraction as threatened counter-expulsion and reverses it into durable settlement.
14:24-27 changes reminder from archival recall into rooted speech that persists, branches, and repeatedly bears effects.
14:28-40 links gratitude to circulation, cultivation, settlement, established practice, and transgenerational communal standing.
14:41-52 joins remembered past Days to present warning and the future Day of account.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence made the compact focus ayah behave like a program: message becomes route, liberation meets counter-expulsion, memory takes material forms in ash and trees, gratitude governs provision, and the final notification returns to warning and remembrance.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus Days may denote only past interventions; including the future Day is a context-driven temporal extension.
The people-as-standing model is strongly activated by later ق و م forms, but the move from lexical recurrence to a theory of peoplehood remains inferential.
The mountain-patience and fire-light readings are deliberately retained branch-level outliers and should not displace the nearer focus senses.
